compiled_state.title: T3 RED: Write failing tests for _phase_remediate bounded retry loop
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: RED

## What
Write RED (failing) unit tests in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh for the bounded retry loop behavior that will be added to _phase_remediate() in T4 GREEN. Tests that exercise the counter/escalation integration require T2 GREEN to be complete first (stub _remediate_counter_increment and _remediate_emit_escalation).

### Test functions to write:

1. t_phase_remediate_stops_at_tier_ceiling
   - Stub _normalize_tier1 to succeed, _dispatch_fix_agent to return 0, _push_fix_branch to return 0
   - Stub _phase_poll to return 1 (CI keeps failing)
   - Stub _remediate_counter_increment to return TIER_CEILING on 5th call for tier 1
   - Assert _phase_remediate exits 2 and emits JSON with stop_reason=TIER_CEILING

2. t_phase_remediate_stops_at_global_ceiling
   - Stub _remediate_counter_increment to return GLOBAL_CEILING on 15th increment
   - Stub all normalizers to succeed, dispatch to return 0
   - Assert _phase_remediate exits 2 and emits JSON with stop_reason=GLOBAL_CEILING

3. t_phase_remediate_stops_on_cannot_proceed
   - Stub _dispatch_fix_agent to return 2 (ESCALATE/CANNOT_PROCEED)
   - Assert _phase_remediate exits 2 with stop_reason=CANNOT_PROCEED in stdout JSON

4. t_phase_remediate_writes_remediation_state_to_state_file
   - Run _phase_remediate (with stubs that exhaust counters)
   - Read state file after exit
   - Assert remediation_attempts_per_tier, remediation_attempts_global, remediation_phase are present in state file

5. t_phase_remediate_dispatches_oscillation_check_on_attempt_2_same_files
   - First attempt: dispatch returns 0 with known file set F; poll fails
   - Second attempt: same file set F → oscillation detected → stub _oscillation_check_cmd called
   - Assert oscillation check invoked and stop_reason=OSCILLATION in escalation JSON

6. t_phase_remediate_injects_budget_pressure_at_attempt_4
   - Drive tier 1 to attempt 4 (stub poll to fail 3 times)
   - Assert _dispatch_fix_agent called with _attempt_num=4 on 4th attempt

## Add RED markers to .test-index for each new test function above

## Files to modify
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- .test-index

## Acceptance criteria
- must: all new test functions defined and fail because _phase_remediate does not yet have retry loop
- must: RED markers added to .test-index
- must: no existing tests broken

GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: Add 2 missing test cases to T3 RED scope:

7. t_phase_remediate_emits_artifact_missing_when_all_tiers_fail
   - Stub all 4 _normalize_tierN functions to return exit 3 (ARTIFACT_MISSING)
   - Stub _fetch_ci_log to return non-zero (no CI log available)
   - Assert _phase_remediate exits 2 with stop_reason=ARTIFACT_MISSING in stdout JSON

8. t_phase_remediate_emits_throttle_pause_when_usage_check_paused
   - Stub _CHECK_USAGE_CMD (or equivalent override) to return exit 2 (MAX_AGENTS=0/pause)
   - Assert _phase_remediate exits 2 with stop_reason=THROTTLE_PAUSE in stdout JSON
   - Assert no _dispatch_fix_agent call made (dispatch skipped on pause)

Add RED markers for both additional tests to .test-index.
